skill.name: research-grants
skill.description: Write research grant proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA. Use agency-specific guidance for structure, review criteria, budgets, impacts, and resubmissions.
skill.summary: Draft research grant proposals with agency-specific guidance for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from grant-writing prose, Markdown fences, and inline file path references. One command-related risk remains: the skill allows Bash and includes a Python script invocation for schematic generation, while the audited package does not include that script. No prompt-injection text or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The skill grants Bash access for a mostly document-writing workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed tools unless command execution is required for a specific reviewed workflow.

remediation.issue: The schematic workflow tells users to run a Python script that is not included in the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the command example, include the script for review, or route figure generation through a separately audited skill.

content.value_statement: Researchers must align proposals with agency rules, review criteria, budgets, and impact expectations. This skill guides NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA proposal drafting with templates and checklists.
actual_capabilities: Explains proposal structures and review criteria for NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA.
Drafts NIH Specific Aims and NSF Project Summary content using included templates.
Develops broader impacts, significance, innovation, approach, and transition narratives.
Creates budget justification language for personnel, equipment, travel, supplies, and indirect costs.
Supports resubmission planning by organizing reviewer comments and response strategies.
Compares agency priorities to help choose a suitable funding path.
limitations: Does not submit applications or interact with agency portals.
Does not replace institutional review, grants administration, or sponsor policy checks.
Agency rules change, so users must verify current solicitations and deadlines.
Cannot validate unpublished data, budgets, personnel commitments, or compliance approvals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Federal Proposal
use_cases.description: Map a research idea into required sections, review criteria, and early drafting tasks.

use_cases.title: Strengthen a Specific Aims Page
use_cases.description: Improve significance, innovation, aims, expected outcomes, and reviewer readability.

use_cases.title: Plan a Technology Transition Proposal
use_cases.description: Frame milestones, deliverables, risks, budget logic, and transition pathways for applied funding.

prompt_templates.title: Outline My Proposal
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me outline a [agency] [mechanism] proposal about [topic]. Include required sections, review criteria, key risks, and drafting priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Core Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft the [section name] for a [agency] proposal. My project goal is [goal], my approach is [approach], and my expected impact is [impact].

prompt_templates.title: Review for Competitiveness
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate critique of an existing draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this grant section for [agency] review criteria. Identify weak claims, missing evidence, unclear logic, and concrete revisions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Resubmission Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a resubmission plan from these reviewer comments: [comments]. Prioritize changes, draft response themes, and flag needed new evidence.

output_examples.input: Help me structure an NSF project summary for a coastal resilience proposal.
output: Overview paragraph for a broad audience.
Intellectual Merit section focused on the scientific gap and method.
Broader Impacts section with measurable education, outreach, and assessment activities.

output_examples.input: Review my NIH Specific Aims page for clarity and competitiveness.
output: Notes on the opening significance statement and knowledge gap.
Aim-by-aim feedback on independence, feasibility, and expected outcomes.
Revision priorities for reviewer readability and stronger impact claims.

output_examples.input: Plan a DARPA technical volume for a prototype research program.
output: Section plan covering technical challenge, approach, milestones, deliverables, and team qualifications.
Transition strategy language tied to operational use and measurable demonstrations.
Risk table themes for feasibility, schedule, integration, and fallback paths.

best_practices: Provide the agency, mechanism, solicitation text, deadline, page limits, and review criteria before drafting.
Share preliminary data, team roles, budget constraints, and institutional requirements early.
Ask for critique against reviewer criteria before requesting polished prose.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a complete final proposal without project details and compliance constraints.
Do not reuse one agency narrative without adapting review criteria and mission fit.
Do not treat generated budgets, deadlines, or policy details as final without verification.

faq.question: Which agencies does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers NSF, NIH, DOE, and DARPA proposal structures, review criteria, and writing strategies.

faq.question: Can it write an NIH Specific Aims page?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance and a template for significance, hypothesis, aims, outcomes, and impact.

faq.question: Can it help with NSF Broader Impacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps create specific, measurable activities for education, participation, dissemination, and societal benefit.

faq.question: Does it calculate final grant budgets?
faq.answer: No. It can draft budget justification language, but users must verify figures with their grants office.

faq.question: Does it know current submission deadlines?
faq.answer: No. Users should check the current solicitation, agency portal, and institutional deadline calendar.

faq.question: Can it help with resubmissions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize reviewer comments, identify revision priorities, and draft response strategies.
